ar.title: فتة ورق العنب باللحم المفروم
ar.intro: طريقة مبتكرة لإعادة تقديم بواقي محشي ورق العنب في طبق جديد فاخر.

steps.n1: يُشوح البصل ثم اللحم مع التوابل ودبس الرمان حتى ينضج ويتفلفل.
steps.n2: يُخلط الأرز مع ورق العنب المقطع ونصف اللحم، ويُسخن.
steps.n3: يُخفق الزبادي مع الطحينة والثوم والليمون والملح.
steps.n4: يُفرد الخبز في قاع الطبق، ثم خليط الأرز وورق العنب، ثم صلصة الزبادي.
steps.n5: يُوزع باقي اللحم والصنوبر المحمص بالسمن على الوجه ويُقدم فوراً.

en.title: Grape Leaf Fatteh with Minced Meat
en.intro: A creative way to turn leftover stuffed grape leaves into a new, festive dish.

steps.n1: Soften the onion, then cook the meat with the spices and pomegranate molasses until done and crumbly.
steps.n2: Mix the rice with the chopped grape leaves and half the meat and warm through.
steps.n3: Whisk the yogurt with the tahini, garlic, lemon and salt.
steps.n4: Spread the bread in the base of the dish, then the rice and grape-leaf mixture, then the yogurt sauce.
steps.n5: Scatter the rest of the meat and the pine nuts toasted in ghee on top and serve at once.

legacySteps: Soften the onion, then cook the meat with the spices and pomegranate molasses until done and crumbly.
Mix the rice with the chopped grape leaves and half the meat and warm through.
Whisk the yogurt with the tahini, garlic, lemon and salt.
Spread the bread in the base of the dish, then the rice and grape-leaf mixture, then the yogurt sauce.
Scatter the rest of the meat and the pine nuts toasted in ghee on top and serve at once.
